raw_text: BREAKING: India's North Eastern power grid experiencing severe instability. Cascading load-shedding across Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura. Sources say malware detected in SCADA systems at substations near Bongaigaon manipulated relay protection settings. POSOCO has activated emergency islanding protocols. This appears to be a coordinated cyber-physical attack on critical grid infrastructure. #PowerGrid #CyberAttack
clean_text: NE power grid instability with cascading load-shedding. Malware in Bongaigaon substation SCADA manipulated relay settings. POSOCO activated emergency islanding. Suspected cyber-physical attack.
